label: Whatever has the nine operates from itself, from intellect as an exercised capacity
meaning: A being g with the nine has intellect and is altogether immutable, which is being in potency in no respect. Its intellect is a capacity to understand (first premise); that capacity is exercised or a potency to understanding (second premise); g is not in potency to understanding, so it actually understands; an exercised capacity to understand is an immanent operation (third premise), so g operates. The act predicate is the nine's own InAct (the one of perfection and supreme goodness) and the potency predicate is the nine's own InPotency (POTENCY_2); the passage from capacity (POTENCY_3) to it is the listed sense bridge, the second premise. No premise mentions life, time or being unmoved; living still needs the route's further steps. Conditional consequence; all three premises stay open, and this replaces the bare restriction by a derivation, it establishes nothing.
